name: giveaway-skills
title_zh: 抽奖规则七件套，从设奖到开奖不重样
tagline_zh: 办抽奖最怕规则漏、开奖被质疑。这套把奖品、参与方式、开奖时间、中奖结构、推广、公平抽签、中奖通知全拆成可复用模板。
tagline_en: Running a giveaway? These kits cover prize, entry, timing, winner structure, promotion, fair draws, and winner.
desc_en: Skills for running better giveaways: prize, entry methods, timing, winner structure, promotion, provably fair draws, winner messages and ideas. Platform-neutral, supported by Gleam.
why_zh: 不是零散点子，是七类决策点各自成件，覆盖一场 giveaway 从设计到收尾的完整决策链。
why_en: Not scattered tips—seven decision-point kits that each slot into your existing flow, covering the full arc from design to.
limit_zh: 只覆盖抽奖活动的规则设计与文案模板，不含具体平台操作步骤或代码实现；需要你自行适配所用抽奖工具的实际字段与限制。
limit_en: Covers rule design and copy templates only, no platform-specific steps or code. You must adapt to your chosen tool's actual fields and limits.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Seven giveaway rule kits, from prize setup to winner notice
